case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1148 OF 2023; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1149 OF 2023

parties.petitioner: Central Bureau of Investigation; Rupesh Balwantbhai Brambhatt

summary: Anticipatory bail granted by High Court despite custodial interrogation necessity; CBI challenged bail order due to absconding, lack of cooperation, evidence tampering risks; High Court cited doubts on acceptance of gratification, no recovery from accused; Supreme Court re-examined evidence including audio recording, WhatsApp communication, trap operation; bail granted conditional on surrender and cooperation; larger conspiracy investigation requiring remand
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; anticipatory bail set aside; order for surrender to custody upheld; CBI granted authority to seek police remand.
